target_description: Clean-room Centipede-inspired arcade game, touch-first and playable on iPhone Safari; deployed via GitHub Pages at https://github.com/wdavidpence/cenitpede-clone

checklist.item: Phase 0 baseline — repo identity and architecture plan documented
checklist.notes: README.md present; docs/architecture.md and docs/project-plan.md authored

checklist.item: Phase 1 vertical slice — playable game loop with player, mushrooms, centipede, collisions, scoring
checklist.notes: Game loop fixed (rAF single chain, timing reset on restart). Three-way shooting with wing-offset spawn points. Space bar works as fire key. All core systems verified: spawn/update/render/collision/cleanup/scoring/game-state paths confirmed in full diff audit.

checklist.item: Phase 2 enemy ecology — segment behavior, head turns, spider/flea/scorpion interactions
checklist.notes: Spider distance-based scoring (300/600/900). Flea spawns mushrooms while descending. Scorpion poisons mushrooms. Centipede 12 segments, head turns with cooldown, tail follows predecessor. Authentic centipede split mechanic. Cleanup removes empty/dead/off-screen groups.

checklist.item: Phase 3 rules and cabinet feel — scoring, audio, particles, HUD, graphics polish
checklist.notes: Authentic scoring. Extra life every 12,000 (max 6). 6→12 Web Audio sound effects with per-event signatures: head_hit, body_hit, spider_kill (dual-osc), flea_kill, scorpion_kill (dual-osc), extra_life arpeggio, game-over 6-note jingle. Particle FX capped at 80. Screen-flash overlays. HUD with localStorage persistence. Procedural pixel-art sprites for all entities: mushroom (spotted cap+stem, HP-based degradation), centipede (mandibles on head, inner highlight), spider (8 legs, eyes), flea (6 legs), scorpion (pincers, stinger tail), player (cockpit, thruster flame flicker). Score popup system (+N floating text). CRT scanline overlay (CSS) + canvas vignette. Wave banner 70 frames with bonus indicator.

checklist.item: Phase 4 iPhone Safari hardening — touch-action, safe-area, orientation
checklist.notes: Orientation lock with fallback. Fullscreen on user gesture. Safe-area layout. Diagonal normalization. Touch-action:none. Viewport-fit=cover. CRT overlay is pointer-events:none and z-indexed above canvas. NOT verified on real device — orientation lock, safe-area insets, and fullscreen API require physical iPhone Safari test.

checklist.item: Phase 5 — progression depth and attract mode
checklist.notes: Wave-scaled difficulty multiplier (0.08/wave, capped 2.5x). Segment count and speed scale with wave. Bonus waves every 5 waves (+4 segments, orange banner, distinct visual). Attract mode screen with animated starfield, title with glow, high score display, control hints. Verified: scorecard PASS, smoke PASS (275 lines), all 9 gameplay markers present, inline JS compiles without error.

checklist.item: Autonomous loop infrastructure — STATE.json + supervisor.sh + docs/autonomous-loop.md

last_test_report.details: Scorecard: syntax OK, smoke PASS, all 9 gameplay markers present. Syntax check: inline JS compiles without error. Smoke tests include diagonal normalization, scoring, centipede split, mushroom HP, extra life cap. All assertions pass. 275 lines of tests.

next_action: Phase 5 remaining: real-device verification of CRT overlay readability on iPhone Safari, attract mode touch-start flow on physical device, bonus wave visual feedback audit. Potential Phase 6: PWA manifest + service worker for offline play, or parallax starfield depth layer behind playfield.
unverified_real_device_checks: CRT scanline overlay opacity (0.06 alpha) may appear too subtle or too heavy on actual Retina display
Attract mode starfield animation performance on older iPhone Safari (12 floating particles)
Touch-start flow from attract mode to game start on physical device
Fullscreen API behavior on iOS Safari when entering from attract mode
Badge/noise texture under CRT vignette may cause visual artifacts on some displays
